authorization: 2026-10-23 precision-first read-side overlay: retain the existing v4 kernel contract and recipe-3 constants; reconstruct stored FP32 quantizer levels without intermediate BF16 metadata/difference rounding
dequantize: FP32 stored scale and normalized zero; FP32(code-zero)*scale; one final RNE BF16 publication. No intermediate BF16 metadata or difference rounding.
quantize: Unchanged v4 FP32 clipping, scale, normalized-zero and INT2 code assignment; the 144-byte packed representation is unchanged.
rotation_artifacts: Reuse the authenticated recipe-3 PT bytes unchanged: per-head Rk/Rv, key mean, model identity and native capture profile. This read-side overlay neither refits nor relabels a PT.
attention: Unchanged v4 BF16 QK/PV operands and FP32 accumulation/max/sum/alpha/LSE; rotated FP32 partials merge before the existing final BF16 inverse rotation.
exact_sources: Sink, recent and current remain in the v4 rotated BF16 frame; physical snapshots, native MTP/APC ownership and fixed-per-forward cache cuts are unchanged.
compatibility: All existing v4 readers already accept mode 0. This overlay changes the selected read arithmetic only; v4 mode-1 coverage, its original acceptance file, all CANN sources and native launch parameters remain separate and unchanged.
accuracy_boundary: Mode 0 avoids extra quantization of the stored FP32 levels. It does not guarantee monotonically smaller error against every original K/V value, attention output or model score. It is an Ascend precision policy, not an upstream bug claim or a claim of CUDA decode equivalence.
